name: Hadi Abdulkader
challenge: Trained as an HVAC and building automation engineer, he knew his systems inside out and wanted to explain them with the same confidence.
transformation: Today he coaches professionals to speak with confidence through his own Public Speaking Gym, in English and Malayalam.

journey.text: Came to Toastmasters for a friendly, honest room to practise speaking in.
Turned what he learned about storytelling, pauses and rhetoric into speeches, then into a blog and two YouTube channels.
Moved from engineering into training, coaching people on public speaking, interviews and team building.
Was the featured speaker at Talk-Masters' 100th meeting, the Grand Jubilee "Century of Voice".

impact.career: Changed careers, from engineering to training and executive coaching.
impact.confidence: Speaks on stage and on camera, sharing public speaking lessons in English and Malayalam.
impact.leadership: Coaches individuals and teams on speaking, interviews and team building.

advice: Treat speaking like a gym: small, regular reps beat waiting until you feel ready.
story: For Hadi, the club is where coaching comes full circle: the room where he still practises what he teaches. Every meeting is another rep, and every evaluation another chance to sharpen the craft he passes on.
contribution: A coach's eye for structure. He helps members tighten their openings, use the pause, and land their message.

name: Prathiba Leo
occupation: TEDx speaker and business communication coach
challenge: Before the stage, her voice lived on the page: a writer with an MBA from the University of Madras and corporate roles at Amazon and Walmart.
transformation: Today she is a TEDx speaker and business communication coach in Dubai, helping professionals and teams speak with clarity.

journey.text: Began her Toastmasters journey at another club, before making Talk-Masters her home in Dubai.
Spoke at TEDxChennaiInstituteOfTechnology, invited under the theme of empowered women.
Moderated the "Real Transformers" panel at Talk-Masters' 100th meeting.

impact.career: Built a coaching practice in business communication, offering one-to-one coaching and team training.
impact.confidence: Went from writing about ideas to delivering them on a TEDx stage.
impact.leadership: Leads panels and trains teams to communicate with clarity.

advice: Write it down first. Clear writing is the fastest way to clear speaking.
story: Toastmasters has travelled with Prathiba, from another club to her home at Talk-Masters. Here she gives back what those rooms gave her, encouraging first-time speakers to trust their own voice.
contribution: Experience from the TEDx stage, and a moderator's gift for drawing people out.

name: Tarannum Sheikh
challenge: An educator for nearly a decade across India and the UAE, she wanted children to build the confidence that years on stage had given her.
transformation: Today she runs Active Kids, an online academy where she and her team teach children public speaking and life skills, and she speaks on the TEDx stage herself.

journey.text: Started as a Toastmaster at another club, and has spent more than nine years in Toastmasters, with over 100 speeches.
Founded Active Kids in May 2020, a virtual academy for children's skill development.
Created Speak & Shine, live public speaking and debate classes for children aged 5 to 14.
Joined Talk-Masters recently, bringing years of experience to a new room.

impact.career: Turned public speaking into an academy that has taught hundreds of children.
impact.leadership: Leads the Active Kids team of trainers.
impact.confidence: Shares her story on the TEDx stage and in her writing as an author.

advice: Start small: one minute on your feet is a beginning.
story: After more than nine years in Toastmasters, Tarannum still treats every meeting as practice. She brings that habit to Talk-Masters, and the same message to the children she teaches: start small, and keep showing up.
contribution: Nearly a decade of Toastmasters experience and more than 100 speeches, shared generously with newer members.

name: Suhayb Shaik
challenge: He started out more at home with code and networks than with a microphone and a room full of faces.
transformation: Today he leads the cyber team at UOWD and the club's public relations, and designed and built this website.

journey.text: Came to Talk-Masters to practise speaking to people, not just screens.
Took on Vice President Public Relations for 2026–27, telling the club's story to Dubai.
Designed and built the club's website, so anyone can see what a meeting is like before they visit.

impact.career: Leads a university cyber team, where explaining a risk clearly matters as much as fixing it.
impact.leadership: Runs the club's public relations as part of the Executive Committee.
impact.confidence: Speaks up in rooms where he once would have stayed quiet.

advice: You don't need to feel ready. Come and watch once, and let the room do the rest.
story: Suhayb joined to practise speaking to people, not just screens, and stayed for the community. As Vice President Public Relations, he now helps tell the club's story to Dubai.
contribution: A technologist's knack for explaining things clearly, and the club's public face online.

name: Jasim Eranhole
occupation: Regional Digital Optimization Specialist, UI/UX Specialist and Graphic Leader
challenge: He started out as a freelance artist and art teacher in India, painting commissions in acrylic and oil, before moving to Kuwait as a graphic designer in 2008.
transformation: Today he leads digital optimisation, UI/UX and graphics for IKEA across the region, from Dubai.

journey.text: Spent more than 15 years in design and digital for retail brands: FedEx Office, Debenhams and IKEA in Kuwait, then Alghanim Industries' Xcite.com, before joining IKEA in Dubai in 2022.
Joined Talk-Masters in June 2024.

story: Jasim has spent his career making ideas clear to other people: first in paint, then in print, shop windows and websites for some of the region's best-known retailers. Since June 2024, he has been practising the spoken side of that craft at Talk-Masters.

name: Nabeel Bava
challenge: He lacked confidence when speaking to people in positions of power or authority, such as managers and senior officials.
transformation: Today he speaks to audiences, addresses groups of colleagues, and expresses his thoughts with much greater confidence and without fear.

journey.text: First joined Talk-Masters in 2021.
Returned to Toastmasters in 2026, after a pause, to keep working on himself.
Became the club's Treasurer for 2026–27, taking on responsibilities beyond public speaking.
Served as Toastmaster of the Day for Meeting #105, after taking on roles such as Timer and Grammarian.
Developing his speaking through speeches, including "Every Car Tells a Story".

impact.career: Toastmasters is helping me communicate more effectively, express ideas clearly, and engage confidently with people at all levels of the organisation.
impact.confidence: I have moved from feeling intimidated when speaking to senior people to expressing my thoughts more confidently in front of groups, colleagues, and audiences.
impact.leadership: Serving as Club Treasurer and taking on meeting roles have helped me develop responsibility, coordination, and leadership skills while contributing to the club’s success.

advice: Don’t wait for confidence before you begin. Take the first step, keep showing up, and let confidence grow through experience.
story: For Nabeel, Toastmasters is not just about delivering speeches. It is about building confidence, expressing his thoughts freely, and growing as a person and a professional. He first joined in 2021, came back in 2026, and now serves as the club's Treasurer.
contribution: A steady hand on the club's finances as Treasurer, and a member who says yes to meeting roles, from Timer and Grammarian to Toastmaster of the Day.
